Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11

Class NetWmState

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.NetWmState
public final class NetWmState extends Object
The pure, X-free decision layer for the EWMH subset the compositor needs (Phase D): _NET_WM_STATE change application, the default state for a window type, the _NET_WM_ALLOWED_ACTIONS derivation, and the _NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW focus-stealing decision.

Every method here is a pure function over enums and EnumSets — no gnu.x11.Display, no Atom ids — so the EWMH semantics are unit-testable headlessly. X11WindowManagerHints owns the (Display-bound) translation from these enums to atom ids and the change_property round-trips; this class owns what the answer is.

Each NetWmState.State/NetWmState.Action constant maps 1:1 to an atom name by the stateAtomName(org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.NetWmState.State)/actionAtomName(org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.NetWmState.Action) convention ("_NET_WM_STATE_" + name() / "_NET_WM_ACTION_" + name()), which is exactly the EWMH spelling, so no lookup table is needed.

    • defaultStateFor

      public static EnumSet<NetWmState.State> defaultStateFor(NetWmState.WindowType type)
      The default _NET_WM_STATE for a window type. Per EWMH, transient / non-taskbar types (dialog, splash, utility, toolbar, menu) start with SKIP_TASKBAR; a modal dialog is also MODAL. Everything else starts with no state.
      Parameters:
      type - the window type (null is treated as NetWmState.WindowType.NORMAL)
      Returns:
      a fresh, possibly empty, state set

    • allowedActions

      public static EnumSet<NetWmState.Action> allowedActions(EnumSet<NetWmState.State> state, boolean resizable, boolean maximizable, boolean closable, boolean fullscreenCapable)
      Derives the _NET_WM_ALLOWED_ACTIONS set from a window's state and capabilities, following the EWMH rules:
      • CLOSE iff closable; MOVE is always offered;
      • RESIZE only if resizable and neither maximized nor fullscreen;
      • MAXIMIZE_VERT/HORZ only if maximizable and not fullscreen;
      • MINIMIZE unless the window skips the taskbar;
      • FULLSCREEN iff fullscreen-capable;
      • ABOVE/BELOW are mutually exclusive with the current state: an ABOVE window is offered BELOW and vice versa, otherwise both.
      Parameters:
      state - the window's current state (null = empty)
      resizable - whether the client is resizable
      maximizable - whether the client is maximizable
      closable - whether the client accepts a delete/close
      fullscreenCapable - whether fullscreen is offered
      Returns:
      the allowed-action set (never null)

    • decideActive

      public static NetWmState.ActiveDecision decideActive(NetWmState.ActiveSource source)
      Decides how to honour an _NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW request. A pager/user activation (or an unspecified source) is honoured; an application-initiated activation is not allowed to steal focus and instead flags the window DEMANDS_ATTENTION (EWMH focus-stealing prevention).
      Parameters:
      source - the request's source indication
      Returns:
      the decision; never null
